about: Live copy and links that the page-builder sections deliberately do not reproduce word for word, each with its reason. scripts/migrate/verify-content.mjs fails on any miss that is not listed here. `copy` entries match page-content copy strings (by page, tag and/or text); `links` entries match page-content links (anchor text + target). `changes` and `structural` document the other deliberate differences; they are not used for matching. Captured from the live site on 2026-10-13.

copy.reason: Form field placeholders and labels are code, not content: the contact section only stores its headings, submit label and success message (docs/CONTENT_MODEL.md §4, contactSection). The forms keep these fields.
The form error message is code (same reason as form fields).
Obsolete: the résumé upload on the live careers form is a dead Webflow placeholder (/api/contact receives no file), so the line asks for something the form cannot take.
Generic alt text Webflow put on every service card image. Cards now use the service's own image and alt (decorative when the title sits beside it).
Generic alt text Webflow put on every blog card image. Cards now use the post's own image and alt (decorative when the title sits beside it).
Card link label, i.e. template text: cards link from the service or post title (seo-requirements §1.5: a lone "Read More" is not enough). The verifier still requires the card's target to be linked.
Card link label in the hidden "All Services" tab pane (template text). Cards link from the service name; the target is still checked.
Card link label in the category tab panes (template text). Cards link from the service name; the target is still checked.

Obsolete UI: the label of a Webflow tab that switched between hidden duplicate panes. The grouped services section lists every service once under its category heading (Residential, Commercial), so there are no tabs.
Webflow lightbox leftover: an unlabeled play-button link to "#" with no video behind it. The photo it sat on is the quote section's image.

Not carried over: a fixed "Active Now" status is false outside office hours (Mon–Fri 9–5), and the CTA status line must be true at every hour (callToAction.statusText). The page uses the shared band, whose status line is the live "Free estimates available". Owner can restore it if wanted.
Same as /our-team: a fixed "Active Now" status is untrue outside office hours; the shared band shows the live "Free estimates available" instead.
Rendered by the jobs section from jobOpening.employmentType = FULL_TIME (the same value feeds JobPosting.employmentType); there is no separate text field for it.

Mesa's tile is siteSettings.homeCity (name "Mesa", linking to /), because Mesa is the homepage, not a location document. No field holds the "Mesa, AZ" label; the other tiles' "City, AZ" comes from cityNameForSeo. The tile's neighborhoods line is kept (homeCity.cardBlurb).
